On Monday, March 14, 2016 at 11:08:43 PM UTC+5:30, Gajanan G Patil wrote:
                  Sir/Mam can we use a strong Non parametric method to analyse the distance data like kernel density estimation method.?????

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] About Analysis using Distance Sampling.
parts:
Gajanan

Methods have been developed for using kernel methods for the analysis of distance sampling data.  A recent example of the use of kernel methods is in

Wald, E.J. and R.M Nielson. 2014. Estimating moose abundance in linear subarctic habitats in low snow conditions with distance sampling and a kernel estimator. Alces 50:133-158.

There is, however, no ability to fit kernel methods in the Distance software package.
